name: Lamiru! -Tsundere Lamia to Love Ero Seikatsu-
original_name: らみる!-ツンデレラミアとらぶエロ性活-
source:
In a world where humans and demons coexist...

A seductive, devouring Lamia girl and young human boy share an apartment.

"Why, why are you staring at me like that...
Ohhh you're thinking about sex again aren't you!
Men are like that. I'm really not an ecchi person.

doing it in all directions... what!? Stop laughing!
Fine, if it'll shut you up, I'll take your sperm."
